edges.label: Event and site
edges.note: The claimed recovery occurred in woodland at Kecksburg, Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania, on the evening of 9 December 1965.

edges.label: Principal field investigator of the Kecksburg witness pool
edges.note: Gordon collected local first-hand accounts over four decades, supplying the witnesses used by Unsolved Mysteries (1990) and the Sci Fi Channel documentary (2003).

edges.label: Four decades of field investigation at the site
edges.note: Gordon, a Greensburg-area researcher, assembled the local witness pool at Kecksburg that supplied the 1990 and 2003 broadcasts and the factual premise of the Kean litigation.
